scenes.prompt: Square 1:1 frame of a boutique hotel suite nightstand vignette, 50mm lens at nightstand height, late evening. A deep ink-navy hand-painted wall — the warmest thing in frame is the lamp — meets a walnut night console with brass cup pulls. To the right a low channel-tufted linen headboard creeps into the frame; the secondary glow is a sliver of city window light dropping a cool blue rectangle on the herringbone oak floor beyond. On the surface beside the lamp: a single leather-bound book, a small brass travel clock, and a faceted crystal carafe of water beaded with condensation. The lamp sits at roughly the height of a seated guest's shoulder, switched ON in warm mode, soft warm 2700-3000K glow pooling on the navy wall behind. Matches the reference image exactly — ribbed tea-brown translucent shade, slim dark stem, round dark base, top touch dial visible. Palette: ink navy, walnut, unlacquered brass, parchment cream, single amber-glow accent. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.

Square 1:1 wide eye-level shot of a moody apartment lounge corner at night, 35mm lens framing the floor lamp at roughly three-quarters frame height between a low plum-velvet sofa and a smoked-glass coffee table. The wall is a velvety aubergine limewash that drinks the light; the secondary source is a soft hallway glow leaking around an open dark-oak doorway in the deep background, giving cool counter-tone to the lamp's warm pool. Styling beats: an aged brass tray on the coffee table holding a faceted crystal decanter and two amber lowball glasses, a draped chocolate mohair throw across the sofa arm, and dried allium stems in a tall stoneware jug on the floor beside the lamp. The lamp stands at roughly chair-arm-plus-shade height, switched ON in warm mode, soft warm 2700-3000K casting a halo on the aubergine wall. Matches the reference image exactly — ribbed tea-brown shade on slim black stem with weighted round black base. Palette: aubergine, plum velvet, smoked glass, aged brass, walnut. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
accents: crystal decanter and amber lowballs on brass tray

scenes.prompt: Square 1:1 frame, 50mm lens at bar-counter height, low angle looking slightly up across a slab of figured walnut bar top in a small speakeasy at night. Behind the bar a smoke-gray fluted-oak back wall lit by a low slot of warm picture-light grazing bottle silhouettes — that is the cool-distant secondary source — while the tea-shaded lamp sits in the front-right third of frame as the warmest hero glow. Styling beats kept tight: a hammered copper cocktail shaker, a single chilled coupe with a twist of lemon peel, a small slate coaster with a sprig of rosemary, all clustered low to leave breathing space around the lamp. The lamp stands at roughly the height of a seated guest's eyeline so the bulb hides behind the ribbed shade. Switched ON in warm mode, soft warm 2700-3000K, the ribbed shade fracturing the glow onto the walnut. Matches the reference image exactly — ribbed translucent tea-brown shade, slim dark stem, round dark metal base. Palette: smoke gray oak, walnut, hammered copper, citrus yellow, amber glow. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.

Square 1:1 three-quarter seated view of a quiet reading nook, 35mm lens at the height of a seated reader, evening. The wall is a warm putty hand-troweled plaster that catches mottled tonal depth; the secondary light is a low stoneware table lamp on a small side table across the nook, throwing a second warm pool so the room reads layered rather than single-source. The floor lamp stands just behind and beside a low bouclé wingback chair, shade roughly at standing shoulder height. Styling beats: a draped sheepskin over the wingback, a woven seagrass basket of rolled linen throws on the wide-plank oak floor, an open hardback face-down on the chair seat, and a single curling stem of magnolia in a raw-clay floor pot. The lamp is switched ON in warm mode, soft warm 2700-3000K halo glowing against the putty plaster. Matches the reference image exactly — slim black stem, weighted round base, small tea-brown ribbed shade tilted slightly forward. Palette: warm putty, oat bouclé, raw clay, oak, sheepskin cream. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
accents: magnolia stem in raw-clay floor pot

scenes.prompt: Square 1:1 low seated view, 50mm lens, of a small covered Mediterranean terrace at deep blue hour. A pale lime-washed exterior wall recedes behind a round limestone bistro table; the secondary source is a soft rectangle of warm interior light spilling from an arched doorway in the far background, balancing the lamp's foreground amber pool. The portable tea-shaded touch lamp sits centered on the limestone tabletop as the hero. Tight styling: a shallow olivewood platter of fresh figs and a torn loaf, a squat terracotta water pitcher, a folded oatmeal linen napkin tied with twine. A single woven rush chair is pulled slightly out of frame at the right edge; clipped boxwood blurs at the table's back. The lamp is switched ON in warm mode at the height of the table setting, soft warm 2700-3000K, glowing visibly against the deep cobalt twilight sky beyond the arch. Matches the reference image exactly — ribbed tea-brown shade, slim dark stem, small round dark base. Palette: lime-washed cream, limestone, terracotta, olive wood, deep cobalt dusk. Sharp focus, natural and photographic, no people, no cinematic moodiness.
accents: olivewood platter with figs and bread
